name: vue-learning-platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:server: cd server && npx tsx watch server.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install

description: Vue.js Learning Platform - 专注于 Vue 3 实战的全栈学习平台
author: AI Learning Platform Team
